findings.description: send_campaign only catches RecipientRefused. Any other exception from mailer.send, such as a dropped SMTP connection or a timeout, propagates out of the loop. The CampaignReport built so far, which records who was already sent to, is lost. A caller retrying the campaign cannot tell which subscribers already received the message, so they may be emailed twice or skipped.
findings.suggestion: Catch the broader error at the send call, record it in the report (for example in a failed map), and decide explicitly whether to continue or stop. Alternatively, attach the partial report to the re-raised exception.
findings.title: Non-refusal send errors discard the partial campaign report
